rows.derivation: HOLD-007: changed revision and current absence block the old authorization.

rows.scenario: Native commitment precedes selected permission revoke.
rows.derivation: HOLD-004/007: revocation blocks later work and does not erase a committed historical effect.

rows.derivation: HOLD-007: any intervening registry decision changes exact selected revision, even without membership loss.

rows.scenario: Exclusive permission end reached without a registry writer.
rows.derivation: HOLD-004/007: time changes current membership while state digest remains unchanged; authorization is capped by exclusive grant end.

rows.scenario: Failure after retained intent and before native invocation.
rows.derivation: HOLD-008: pending intent is retained; recording intent proves no effect and does not authorize blind retry.
HOLD-008: possible acceptance requires protected reconciliation, not inferred absence.

rows.scenario: Native acceptance followed by outcome-write failure.
rows.derivation: HOLD-008: inability to establish the retained result leaves possible effect and prohibits blind reinvocation.

rows.scenario: Protected process checkpoint restart of retained pending intent.
rows.derivation: HOLD-008: restart reconstructs exact retained authorization and invocation identity. This is process-local export/import, not durable storage proof.

rows.scenario: Exact retry of established committed invocation.
rows.derivation: HOLD-008: same exact invocation identity returns its established result without another call.

rows.scenario: Concurrent same-actor incompatible grants from two classes, same expected revision.
rows.derivation: HOLD-004/005: expected-revision transition serializes conflicts across classes and approvers.

rows.scenario: At64 retained events, selected permission remains active.
rows.derivation: HOLD-005/006: replay/export survives but fresh authority and commitment stop before unretainable revocation risk.

rows.scenario: Attempt to substitute an older self-consistent state into an already owned newer registry.
rows.derivation: HOLD-001/006/007: protected owned-root installation rejects rollback substitution. This local rejection does not prove real provider authentication or truthful latest-state selection.

rows.scenario: Same-thread native callback attempts reentrant permission write.
rows.derivation: HOLD-007/008: the selected host cannot allow covered conditions to change inside one commitment critical section. Reentrant path must reject or use a stronger coherent ordering; this demonstration selects rejection.

rows.scenario: Public denial rendering of a protected holdings failure.
rows.derivation: HOLD-008: detailed adapter result is protected; public rendering must not reveal its inventory or reasons.
